latin_incipit: Praeter syllogismum categoricum et hypotheticum: datur genus syllogismorum compositivorum.
charge: Some scholars argued that adding new syllogistic forms violated Aristotelian orthodoxy.
defense: Avicenna demonstrated that composite syllogisms follow valid logical principles and expand the field of rigorous reasoning to phenomena that defy Aristotelian categories (especially relevant to occult and liminal knowledge).

english_translation.text: Beyond categorical and hypothetical syllogisms, there exists a third kind: compositive syllogisms.
